caseName: City of Chicago v. Chicago Railways Co.
caseNameFull: City of Chicago v. Chicago Railways Company
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Illinois.
attorneys: Mr. Chester E. Cleveland, with whom Mr. Samuel A. Ettelson and Mr. George B. Gillespie were on the brief, for plaintiff in error., Mr. Harry P. Weber, with whom Mr. W. W. Gurley, Mr. James M. Sheean and Mr. George W. Miller were on the brief, for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Pawhuska v. Pawhuska Oil & Gas Co., 250 U. S. 394; Chicago v. Dempcy, 250 U. S. 651.
